description: This is a Java test class named 'GlobalErrorRegistryTestCases' that contains various test cases for verifying the registration and annotation of exception classes related to the Ditto service. It checks that exceptions are correctly annotated, present in the classpath, and contain necessary methods for JSON parsing.

classes.name: GlobalErrorRegistryTestCases
classes.description: An abstract test class that verifies the presence, annotation, and correctness of exception classes in the classpath related to JSON parsing within the Ditto service.

methods.name: sampleCheckForExceptionFromEachModule
methods.description: Verifies that all modules containing exceptions that need to be deserialized are present in the classpath by checking annotated classes.

methods.name: ensureSamplesAreComplete
methods.description: Ensures the set of sample classes is up to date and includes all packages with exceptions.

methods.name: getPackagesDistinct
methods.description: Helper method that retrieves distinct package sets from a collection of classes.

methods.name: allExceptionsRegistered
methods.description: Checks that all subclasses of DittoRuntimeException (except DittoJsonException) are annotated with JsonParsableException.

methods.name: allRegisteredExceptionsContainAMethodToParseFromJson
methods.description: Verifies that each exception class annotated with JsonParsableException contains a method to parse from JSON, with the correct method name and signature.

methods.name: assertAnnotationIsValid
methods.description: Validates that the JsonParsableException annotation on a class specifies a valid method for JSON parsing.
